## KEY POINT

Maximal hypertrophy can be best achieved by systematically varying the exercises performed and fully working all aspects of the targeted musculature, varying the angles and planes involved, and using both multijoint and single-joint exercises.

Maximal hypertrophy can be achieved only by systematically varying the exercise performed and fully working all aspects of the targeted musculature. This section explains how to employ these strategies to maximize hypertrophy in each of the major muscle groups.
